h1: Custom Qtees Backpacks for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Qtees backpacks in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate gifts, events, and employee recognition.
introHtml: Qtees backpacks combine durable polyester construction with a classic silhouette, making them a reliable choice for corporate giveaways and employee onboarding kits. Unlike generic backpacks, Qtees offers consistent quality across bulk orders, with options for full-color screen printing or embroidery on the front panel. Whether you need 50 or 500, these backpacks provide practical storage for laptops, books, and daily essentials while keeping your logo front and center.
heroAltText: Custom Qtees backpacks with embroidered logo, black polyester fabric, front zippered pocket, padded straps
